posts.title: Karibu to BongoPlanet
posts.summary: What BongoPlanet is, and what you can expect here.
posts.body:
BongoPlanet is a home for Tanzania’s entertainment and lifestyle: the music, the films, the nights out and the language of the street.

Here you will find guides like **Bongo 101**, the **Mtaani Dictionary**, and new stories as we publish them.

Have a story, an event or a word to share? Write to us at [iamisaacjob@gmail.com](mailto:iamisaacjob@gmail.com). Asante sana, and karibu.
